name: Sandy Bay
source:
Welcome to 'Sandy Bay'! Dive into the story of Aimee, a lively 19-year-old, who's just swapped the bustling streets of Sydney for the chill vibes of Sandy Bay, thanks to her dad landing a killer job. It's all about new beginnings and maybe, just maybe, some saucy adventures!

Get ready to call the shots and guide Aimee through a whirlwind of choices. Will she stick to her long-distance boyfriend, or will the tempting alternatives have her questioning – is the grass greener on the other side? It's all about loyalty, discovering new relationships, and maybe a bit of cheeky cheating – we don't judge!

[From [url=https://lexapps.itch.io/sandy-bay]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到“桑迪湾”！深入了解Aimee的故事，她是一位活泼的19岁女孩，由于她的父亲找到了一份杀手级的工作，她刚刚从悉尼熙熙攘攘的街道来到了桑迪湾的寒冷氛围。这一切都是关于新的开始，也许，只是也许，一些俏皮的冒险！

准备好发号施令，引导艾米完成一系列的选择。她会坚持和远距离男友在一起，还是诱人的选择会让她产生疑问——那边的草更绿吗？这一切都与忠诚、发现新的关系有关，也许还有一点厚颜无耻的欺骗——我们不会评判！
